description: This file contains functions and constants related to managing frames and elements within frames in a drawing or diagramming application, including operations like adding/removing elements to/from frames, checking overlaps, and retrieving frame-related elements.

methods.name: bindElementsToFramesAfterDuplication
methods.description: Reassigns frame IDs for duplicated elements based on a mapping, maintaining frame associations after duplication.

methods.name: isElementIntersectingFrame
methods.description: Checks if a given element intersects with a specified frame based on line segment intersection.

methods.name: getElementsCompletelyInFrame
methods.description: Retrieves elements fully within a given frame, excluding groups containing frame-like elements.

methods.name: isElementContainingFrame
methods.description: Determines if an element contains a specific frame.

methods.name: getElementsIntersectingFrame
methods.description: Returns elements that intersect with a given frame.

methods.name: elementsAreInFrameBounds
methods.description: Checks if elements are within the bounds of a frame.

methods.name: elementOverlapsWithFrame
methods.description: Checks if an element overlaps, intersects, or is contained within a frame.

methods.name: isCursorInFrame
methods.description: Checks if cursor coordinates are within a frame.

methods.name: groupsAreAtLeastIntersectingTheFrame
methods.description: Checks if any group elements intersect with a frame.

methods.name: groupsAreCompletelyOutOfFrame
methods.description: Checks if all group elements are outside a frame.

methods.name: groupByFrameLikes
methods.description: Creates a map of frame IDs to their child elements.

methods.name: getFrameChildren
methods.description: Retrieves children elements of a specific frame.

methods.name: getFrameLikeElements
methods.description: Filters and returns all frame-like elements.

methods.name: getRootElements
methods.description: Returns root elements, considering frames and non-frame elements.

methods.name: getElementsInResizingFrame
methods.description: Gets elements within a frame during resize, considering group memberships.

methods.name: omitGroupsContainingFrameLikes
methods.description: Filters out elements inside groups that contain frame-like elements.

methods.name: getContainingFrame
methods.description: Returns the frame containing a specific element.

methods.name: filterElementsEligibleAsFrameChildren
methods.description: Filters elements that can be children of a specific frame.

methods.name: addElementsToFrame
methods.description: Adds elements to a frame, maintaining order and group memberships.

methods.name: removeElementsFromFrame
methods.description: Removes specified elements from their frames.

methods.name: removeAllElementsFromFrame
methods.description: Removes all elements from a specified frame.

methods.name: replaceAllElementsInFrame
methods.description: Replaces all elements in a frame with new elements.

methods.name: updateFrameMembershipOfSelectedElements
methods.description: Updates frame membership for selected elements based on app state.

methods.name: omitPartialGroups
methods.description: Filters out group elements that are only partially within a frame.

methods.name: getTargetFrame
methods.description: Determines the target frame for adding or removing an element.

methods.name: isElementInFrame
methods.description: Checks if an element is within a frame, considering selection and dragging state.

methods.name: shouldApplyFrameClip
methods.description: Determines if an element should be clipped within a frame based on overlap or containment.

methods.name: getDefaultFrameName
methods.description: Returns default name for a frame.

methods.name: getFrameLikeTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of a frame, defaulting if null.

methods.name: getElementsOverlappingFrame
methods.description: Returns elements overlapping a frame.

methods.name: frameAndChildrenSelectedTogether
methods.description: Checks if multiple selected elements include a frame and its children.
